results.answer: Your block on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega sits about 39 ft above sea level and was built mainly in the early 1940s—oldest home dates to 1908, newest to 2004. It’s known for WWII‑era “patriotic” houses named by builder Henry Doelger (Rainbow House, Freedom House), the 1878 King Philip clipper wreck buried on Ocean Beach, and the Noriega seawall whose sand was pushed back in June 2023. The whole stretch rests on dune sand, lies just 2–3 miles offshore from the San Andreas Fault, and was the epicenter of the 1906 earthquake. Since April 2025, part of Upper Great Highway has been turned into Sunset Dunes park. Street sweeping: east side Mon & Thu 1st & 3rd noon–2pm (next 2026‑11‑16); west side Thu 1st, 3rd, 5th noon–2pm (next 2026‑11‑19).
